label: pjm 97 measured interfaces
definition: PJM 97 — KEEPER (owner-directed promotion 2026-07-10, rule 1: most structurally faithful, not lowest residual). Recipe: pjm-94 recipe byte-faithful via replay_keeper.build_kwargs + pjm_seam_measured_ladder + pjm_measured_interface_limits (NEW: the measured HOURLY PJM Data Miner 2 transfer limits — transfer-interface-limits clean datatype, rules 13/14 measured-physical — replace the static ttc_mw / pjm_congestion pooled medians on the seven mapped internal links, forward direction, min(pre,post) where both publish; constants.PJM_INTERFACE_LINK_MAP documents the crosswalk and its rule-14 boundary misalignments) + pjm_reserve_pergen + measured_ramp_capability (pjm-81 owner recommendation; deliverable ramp pool 48.2 -> 37.8 GW under the measured intake). WHY KEEPER: both transmission channels — external seams (measured Q-Q ladder) and internal interfaces (measured hourly caps) — now run on published measured data with ZERO fitted scalars, superseding the static Tier-3 estimates and pooled medians the pjm-94 lineage carried; per rule 1 a structurally-correct measured mechanism is never rejected for its residual, and the owner directed that the build continue from this base. The mechanism carries no tuned parameter, so the rule-22 LOO clause (which cross-validates TUNED mechanism changes) is vacuous here — noted in the attestation. HONEST FIT RECORD (vs pjm-94): C1 15/16 (free 11/12, vs 14/16 free 10/12 — the 2023 CC_REGULAR system cell clears, carried by the seam ladder), C2 CAVEAT (+3.0% 2025 gas, commercial band, was PASS), C3a FAIL (-15.6% 2025, was -14.9%), C3b FAIL 3-of-3 (NRMSE 0.232/0.219/0.249; pjm-94 failed 2025 only — the regression enters with the seam ladder, the interface limits are neutral on top of it), C3c FAIL 0/6, 0/18, 0/59 h >$200 (unchanged), C4/C5a PASS. The measured caps BIND (AEP->Dominion at its hourly limit ~94% of hours; West_APS->Dominion 7876/3801/2559 h; ComEd->AEP 987/2202/3029 h): the ComEd corridor over-run is cut by the measured 50045005 cap (ComEd CT 2024 +73->+35%, 2025 +111->+85%), while the eastern under-run persists (Dominion CC 2023 -78->-81%, Dominion CT 2025 -72->-80%, EMAAC CT -80->-83%, SWMAAC CC 2025 -88->-93%) and CT per-plant capture falls (2023 median r 0.301->0.246). ATTRIBUTION (the open root cause this keeper hands to G-20): with both transmission channels measured, Dominion becomes a through-corridor (imports at cap from AEP/West_APS, re-exports at cap into SWMAAC 5193-6703 h/yr) and no cut binds around the MAD zones — the Carolinas/TVA/LGEE seam supply replaces what the west can no longer push, zonal LMPs barely separate, and 2025 net export overshoots (27.1 vs 18.0 TWh). The eastern locals are priced/committed out even under measured physics, so the residual work is the Phase-1 commitment posture of eastern CC/CT (pjm-81 attribution) and the Dominion seam-inflow structure — an offer/commitment problem, not a transmission one. Determination basis: governance attestation + DOF ledger in the bundle (calibration_attestation.json); zero-forcing ablation twin registered and linked (rule 21). Registered per rule 15.
market_story: ST_GAS/CT net-load drags encode PJM's real reliability-commitment posture (measured CAMPD block-running, weeks-to-months online); coal take-or-pay and CHP steam-following are contract/steam-host physics; nuclear is must-run baseload. Without them the LP under-commits the units PJM actually holds online for reliability rather than energy merit -- the twin shows what each floor buys, not residual-buying.
